## resumed

You were paused and have been resumed. Continue the task where you left off.

## idle

You have not done anything for a while. Carry on with your task — or, if you need something only a person can give, ask for it with ask_person (every such decision in one call) and end your turn.

## stuck-turn

A tool call of yours was open for 10 minutes, so dude stopped your turn. Tell the people in the session briefly what you were doing and that it got stuck, then carry on or ask them.

## host-moved

Your host was replaced: lux moved you to another one, and your turn was cut off. Your workspace and conversation are as you left them; processes you had running are not. Carry on with your task where you left off.

## move-kept

You asked for XL; lux kept you on Large: lux said no

## move-kept-reset

You were to move back to XL; lux kept you on Large: lux said no.

## moved-pool

You now run on Large (4 CPUs · 16 GiB · 40 GiB) in highmem. Start again any server or watcher you had running. Carry on.

## moved-back

Moved back to Standard by Ana.

## moved-back-note

Moved back to Standard by Ana: the suite fits again

## linked

A member linked GLD/api; it is checked out at /workspace/repos/GLD/api (read only) unless dude tells you its clone failed.

## clone-failed-task

api could not be checked out (repository 'x' not found). It is not in /workspace; carry on without it, or ask a person to check the repository's URL and access.
